scope: References to collected models and data used during local development. Third-party bot code, pretrained weights, datasets and private run history are not bundled in this release.

dashboard.name: Poker Bot Challenge Competition
dashboard.note: Local dashboard for collecting poker agents, training policies and evaluating experiments.

models.name: Fullhouse Bot
models.author: Advit Arora (advitrocks9)
models.license: MIT for upstream-authored code; vendored engine excluded; model/data scope needs separate confirmation
models.license_evidence: Pinned upstream LICENSE and local archived license notice
models.note: Pretrained Deep CFR policy and preflop data used unchanged locally. Adapter translates chip units, legal actions, features/history, imports and RNG. Do not confuse with Fullhouse Hackathon example bots.

models.name: Tumbleweed Gunslinger
models.author: Timo Janssen (TimoJanssen1)
models.license_evidence: Local pinned UPSTREAM.json and archived LICENSE: Copyright (c) 2026 Timo Janssen
models.note: Rules, Monte Carlo equity and public opponent statistics; no neural weights. Adapter changes chip scaling, street events, self-exclusion, legal actions and state isolation.

models.name: V16
models.author: lucashsu007-create
models.license_evidence: Pinned upstream LICENSE and local archived notice: Copyright (c) 2026 lucashsu007-create
models.note: Rule-based ranges, opponent statistics and Monte Carlo equity; no neural weights. Adapter translates units/history/actions, isolates state and corrects multiway split-pot credit.

models.name: Talibus
models.author: Taliwanmli
models.license_evidence: Pinned upstream LICENSE and local archived notice: Copyright (c) 2026 Taliwanmli
models.note: Six-player pretrained strategy ONNX used locally without retraining. Python adapter translates the original 510 features and 13 action slots. Upstream Rust real-time search is not included; original training was six-player.

models.name: GTOBot
models.author: luckyone18/Poker contributors
models.license_evidence: Local pinned UPSTREAM.json explicitly records no license found at this revision
models.note: Permission unresolved; do not redistribute this adaptation. Heuristic mixed strategy, not solved GTO. Local port changes evaluator, equity estimator, split-pot accounting, RNG and SDK interface; 100 trials per equity estimate.

models.name: MonteCarloBot
models.author: luckyone18/Poker contributors
models.license_evidence: Local pinned UPSTREAM.json explicitly records no license found at this revision
models.note: Permission unresolved; do not redistribute this adaptation. Local port uses eval7, independent RNG, fractional split pots and 200 equity trials; translates SDK observations and legal actions.

models.name: SmartBot
models.author: luckyone18/Poker contributors
models.license_evidence: Local pinned UPSTREAM.json explicitly records no license found at this revision
models.note: Permission unresolved; do not redistribute this adaptation. Local port changes evaluator, equity estimator, split-pot accounting, RNG and SDK interface; 100 equity trials.

models.name: Fullhouse Aggressor
models.author: Fullhouse Hackathon contributors
models.license_evidence: Pinned upstream LICENSE: Copyright (c) 2026 Fullhouse Hackathon
models.note: Unchanged upstream decision function with MAC state translation and legal-action clamping. A heuristic example bot, not a neural model.

models.name: Fullhouse Mathematician
models.author: Fullhouse Hackathon contributors
models.license_evidence: Pinned upstream LICENSE: Copyright (c) 2026 Fullhouse Hackathon
models.note: Pot-odds calling rule preserved with MAC interface translation. Duplicate ref_bot_2 policy was not a separate collected baseline.

models.name: Fullhouse Shark
models.author: Fullhouse Hackathon contributors
models.license_evidence: Pinned upstream LICENSE: Copyright (c) 2026 Fullhouse Hackathon
models.note: Preflop and position rules preserved, including documented rank-ordering quirks; MAC interface translation and legal clamping.

models.name: PyPokerEngine Honest
models.author: ishikota / PyPokerEngine contributors
models.license_evidence: Archived LICENSE: Copyright (c) 2016 ishikota; pinned source in PUBLIC_BASELINES.md
models.note: Call/fold rule based on estimated win probability >= 1/table size. Local evaluator and 128-trial cap replace the original 1,000 simulations; ties counted as wins as upstream.

models.name: RLCard Rule V1
models.author: DATA Lab at Texas A&M University / RLCard contributors
models.license_evidence: Archived license notice: Copyright (c) 2019 DATA Lab at Texas A&M University; pinned source in PUBLIC_BASELINES.md
models.note: Original rule class retained with translated card format and legal actions. Fixed-limit raises map to minimum no-limit raises; performance in the original game is not reproduced by this translation.

models.name: DeepBot Conservative
models.author: cyril (source headers) and tamlhp/deepbot-poker contributors
models.license_evidence: Archived LICENSE and local ADAPTATION.md; archived source review reported no upstream NOTICE at the pinned revision
models.note: Ports the high >= K and low >= J calling rule. No neural weights or Monte Carlo estimator. SDK coerces a free fold to check.

models.name: DeepBot Maniac
models.author: cyril (source headers) and tamlhp/deepbot-poker contributors
models.license_evidence: Archived LICENSE and local ADAPTATION.md; archived source review reported no upstream NOTICE at the pinned revision
models.note: Ports pot-sized aggression on unraised streets and double-pot aggression after a raise, with legal SDK actions. No card-dependent decisions or neural weights.

models.name: DeepBot Equity
local_aliases: Initial registered snapshot named lil fruit
models.author: cyril (source headers) and tamlhp/deepbot-poker contributors
models.license_evidence: Archived LICENSE and local ADAPTATION.md; archived source review reported no upstream NOTICE at the pinned revision
models.note: Ports thresholds 1/n, 1.2/n, 1.4/n and 1.6/n. Local 100-trial equity estimator replaces native OMPEval and gives fractional split-pot credit. Alias applies only to the inspected original snapshot, not later similarly named variants.

models.name: DeepBot Candid
models.author: cyril (source headers) and tamlhp/deepbot-poker contributors
models.license_evidence: Archived LICENSE and local ADAPTATION.md; archived source review reported no upstream NOTICE at the pinned revision
models.note: Ports equity-to-the-seventh-power sizing, branch order and two-raise gate. Replaces native equity calculation with 100 local trials; translates SDK contributions and legal actions.

models.name: DeepBot PStrat
models.author: cyril (source headers) and tamlhp/deepbot-poker contributors
models.license_evidence: Archived LICENSE and local ADAPTATION.md; archived source review reported no upstream NOTICE at the pinned revision
models.note: Ports range, position, stack and sizing rules while retaining documented upstream quirks. SDK evaluator, street-total action mapping and aggregate-pot semantics replace source engine behavior.

datasets.name: Poker Hand Histories (PHH dataset)
datasets.author: Universal, Open, Free, and Transparent Computer Poker Research Group
datasets.license_evidence: Local LICENSE: Copyright (c) 2024-2025 Universal, Open, Free, and Transparent Computer Poker Research Group
datasets.note: The collection credits HandHQ, Pluribus histories published with Brown and Sandholm (2019), televised WSOP hands and historical sources. GitHub and full Zenodo release contents differ. Local lookup/BC data are derived subsets; record actual source split and retain dataset attribution. Pluribus histories are not original Pluribus code or weights.

dependencies.name: macpoker
dependencies.author: MAC poker tournament organizers
dependencies.note: Official game engine, bot API, protocol runner and house bots. Installed separately; no SDK source or wheel is vendored. The same-version official wheel was replaced: compared with the prior development install, only cli.py and hand.py change the maximum seat count from nine to ten and matching help/docstrings. Other Python source files match byte-for-byte. Pin the artifact hash as well as version.

local_artifacts.name: PPO_5p_600_000_v3
local_artifacts.note: Local frozen actor shared by PPO Alone, PPO + lookup, PPO + rollouts, and PPO + lookup + rollouts. Checksum identifies bytes; complete teacher/data lineage and redistribution terms need a model card before model publication.
